title: KhemSAR: Rigorous AI-Assisted QSAR/SAR Modeling, Scientific Tutoring, and Bioisosteric De Novo Design Platform
description: KhemSAR is an open-source, cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows) and trilingual (ES/EN/PT) scientific platform for paper-ready QSAR/SAR modeling, multi-database bioactivity curation, OECD-compliant validation, activity cliffs and matched molecular pair analysis, bioisosteric de novo molecule generation, 3D preparation for molecular docking and dynamics, and interactive AI-assisted scientific tutoring.

creators.name: Bolivar Avila, Santiago Jr.
